title: Chameleon wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail spiral -->
  <path d='M30 74 C18 74 14 64 20 57 C26 50 36 54 34 62 C33 67 28 67 27 63' fill='none' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='66' rx='24' ry='13' fill='#4fdc72'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='71' rx='18' ry='7' fill='#a6f2b4'/>
  <!-- back crest -->
  <path d='M34 56 L42 48 L50 55 L58 47 L66 54 L72 50 L72 58' fill='none' stroke='#2fa84e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M40 78 L38 86 M38 86 L32 88 M38 86 L44 90' fill='none' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 78 L66 86 M66 86 L60 90 M66 86 L72 88' fill='none' stroke='#3fbf5f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='52' r='13' fill='#5be87e'/>
  <!-- casque / helmet bump -->
  <path d='M68 42 C70 34 80 33 84 40' fill='#2fa84e'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='5.5' fill='#f2f7a0'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='2.6' fill='#1d2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='81.2' cy='48.8' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M84 58 Q88 61 91 58' fill='none' stroke='#1f7a3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- curled tongue -->
  <path d='M89 56 C95 52 97 44 92 44' fill='none' stroke='#ff5c8a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M66 30 L74 8 L86 32 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M69 24 L80 26 M71 17 L79 19' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='8' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x='64' y='28' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
